products.title: Cardinal Logo Tee
products.description: The one that started it — a heavyweight 240gsm cotton tee with our bird mark screen-printed big across the chest in plastisol that will not peel. Boxy body, ribbed collar, dropped shoulder. Wears in, never wears out.
products.seoTitle: Cardinal Logo Tee — heavyweight graphic tee | Cardinal Supply
products.seoDescription: A boxy 240gsm cotton tee with a big screen-printed chest logo. In black, bone and cardinal red.

products.title: Static Print Tee
products.description: A glitched, blown-out static graphic printed edge to edge on the same heavyweight blank. Loud front, hit on the back, built to be the reason someone stops you on the street. Small run — when it is gone, it is gone.
products.seoTitle: Static Print Tee — all-over graphic tee | Cardinal Supply
products.seoDescription: A blown-out static graphic on a heavyweight cotton blank, front and back. In black, white and acid.

products.title: Heavyweight Hoodie
products.description: A 400gsm brushed-back fleece pullover with a double-lined hood, boxy fit and heavy metal-tipped drawcords. The kind of hoodie that stands up on its own. Printed small so it reads clean under a jacket or loud on its own.
products.seoTitle: Heavyweight Hoodie — 400gsm brushed fleece | Cardinal Supply
products.seoDescription: A 400gsm brushed-back fleece pullover with a double-lined hood and boxy fit. In black, ash and cardinal.

products.title: Boxy Crewneck
products.description: The hoodie’s quieter cousin — same 400gsm fleece, cropped a touch boxier, ribbed at the cuffs and hem so it sits right. Layer it, wear it solo, throw it under the coaches jacket. The workhorse of the fleece rack.
products.seoTitle: Boxy Crewneck — 400gsm heavyweight fleece | Cardinal Supply
products.seoDescription: A boxy 400gsm fleece crewneck, ribbed at cuff and hem. In black, bone and forest.

products.title: Sherpa Coaches Jacket
products.description: A classic snap-front coaches jacket lined with heavy sherpa — wind-blocking nylon shell, deep hand pockets, our mark embroidered at the chest and printed big across the back. The outer layer the whole fit is built around.
products.seoTitle: Sherpa Coaches Jacket — snap-front, sherpa-lined | Cardinal Supply
products.seoDescription: A snap-front nylon coaches jacket with a heavy sherpa lining and back print. In black and concrete.

products.title: Utility Cargo Pant
products.description: A relaxed, tapered cargo in tough cotton twill — six real pockets, reinforced knees, an adjustable hem so you can stack them or crop them clean over a boot. Made to haul gear and take a season of abuse without blinking.
products.seoTitle: Utility Cargo Pant — tapered cotton twill | Cardinal Supply
products.seoDescription: A tapered six-pocket cargo pant in tough cotton twill with an adjustable hem. In black, olive and concrete.

products.title: Heavyweight Sweatpant
products.description: The bottom half of the fleece set — 400gsm brushed-back, tapered leg, ribbed cuff, deep zip pockets. Matches the hoodie and the crew color for color so you can run the full tracksuit or break it up.
products.seoTitle: Heavyweight Sweatpant — 400gsm brushed fleece | Cardinal Supply
products.seoDescription: A tapered 400gsm fleece sweatpant with a ribbed cuff and zip pockets. In black, ash and cardinal.

products.title: Six-Panel Cap
products.description: A structured six-panel cap in heavy cotton twill with an embroidered bird mark, a curved brim broken in just enough, and a metal buckle strap. The finisher on any fit, in colors that go with all of it.
products.seoTitle: Six-Panel Cap — structured cotton twill | Cardinal Supply
products.seoDescription: A structured six-panel cap with an embroidered mark and buckle strap. In black, concrete and cardinal.

products.title: Heavy Canvas Tote
products.description: A 16oz cotton-canvas tote with a big screen-printed logo, boxed corners and webbing straps built to carry a laptop, a change of gear and a six-pack without giving out. The bag that comes with you everywhere.
products.seoTitle: Heavy Canvas Tote — 16oz printed cotton canvas | Cardinal Supply
products.seoDescription: A 16oz cotton-canvas tote with a big printed logo and webbing straps. In natural and black.

products.title: Cuffed Beanie
products.description: A tight-knit ribbed beanie with a folded cuff and a woven bird tab — warm, low-profile, and the fastest way to finish a fit when it is cold. Runs true, stretches to fit, holds its shape wash after wash.
products.seoTitle: Cuffed Beanie — ribbed knit | Cardinal Supply
products.seoDescription: A tight ribbed cuffed beanie with a woven tab. In black, ash, cardinal and forest.
